prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Produce one isolated Stone Age game building sprite. Attached image 1 (hut) and image 2 (camp scene) are locked style anchors: closely match their fine controlled dark ink contours, sparse interior linework, restrained natural earth-tone wash, two-tone upper-left illumination. Orthographic vertically overhead camera with only a slight front-face cheat, no isometric perspective. Uniform solid pure #FF00FF magenta backdrop everywhere outside the object, including holes. No extraneous surrounding ground apron, cast shadow, text, labels, people, photo, 3D rendering, pixel art, gradients, modern objects, or metal. Center with margin, crisp edges. South is bottom of image. A compact 1x1-tile circular shallow storage pit with a close wicker-lined earthen rim, dark interior containing a small woven sack, removable woven lid leaned against north rim, clear accessible working side south. Only minimal structural earthen rim; no surrounding ground apron.
